text:
2 former Cleburne High School athletes on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
By
W. W. PerryTwo former Cleburne High School athletes appear on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Sophomore Allyson Reed is with UT Permian Basin women's soccer, which hosts Wayland Baptist University (Texas) on Sept. 2.
The sports represented are women's soccer and women's volleyball, with UT Permian Basin and Northwest Missouri State listed. Those teams have five scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and schedule appear below.
Former Cleburne High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Allyson Reed
UT Permian Basin women's soccer — Lone Star
Schedule: Hosts Wayland Baptist University (Texas) on September 2 in Odessa, TX; Hosts New Mexico Highlands University on September 5 in Odessa, TX
Grace Thorne
Northwest Missouri State women's volleyball — MIAA
Schedule: Hosts Southwest Minnesota State on September 4 in St. Joseph, MO; Hosts Northern State on September 5 in St. Joseph, MO; Hosts Oklahoma Christian on September 5 in St. Joseph, MO
